name: David Gadyan
headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | LLM & Agentic Systems | MLOps on AWS/Kubernetes
summary: ML engineer and data scientist with 8 years, 180+ delivered projects and 50+ long-term clients (Upwork Expert-Vetted, top 1%). Ships production LLM systems — RAG, LangChain/LangGraph agents with MCP tool use, FastAPI on Docker/Kubernetes/AWS — incl. a HIPAA-compliant underwriting assistant that cut turnaround from days to minutes.

entries.heading: Upwork (Freelancer)

bullets: 8 years and 180+ projects for 100+ clients worldwide (50+ long-term); Upwork Expert-Vetted (top 1% of the platform), $500k+ earned, 8,700+ hours.

**[Virgil.ai — agentic health-insurance assistant](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-34/)** — Built the LLM backend (LangChain + FastAPI + OpenAI, MCP tools, Docker/Kubernetes on AWS) that onboards US users, automates medication-coverage lookup and underwriting under HIPAA controls; underwriting cut from days to minutes.

**[Document OCR & data extraction](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-14/)** — Replaced manual entry of driver licences and insurance cards at a healthcare booking platform with a structured-extraction REST API; benchmarked YOLO/NLP models vs AWS Textract, shipped Textract + regex, latency ~10 s → under 5 s per image.

**[Regulatory RAG assistant](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-31/)** — Shipped a LangChain + GPT-4 + Pinecone RAG chatbot over multi-jurisdiction crypto regulation: 4-format ingestion with OCR of scanned PDFs, sub-second retrieval, inline citations; delivered with Docker config.

**[LangGraph multi-agent document review](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-28/)** — Architected a LangChain + LangGraph workflow on Gemini for a law firm's due diligence: user-defined verification checks, external ABN/ACN API validation, long-contract processing, auto-generated Word reports and a replication package.

**[Fine-tuned open-source LLM service](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-22/)** — Fine-tuned Mistral 7B (HuggingFace + LangChain) where hosted APIs were unsuitable; served it as a FastAPI REST API on rented GPUs (Paperspace, DigitalOcean, GCP) over 3 contracts.
